newsitem.title: USA: Duke and partners win Peru gas block.
newsitem.headline: Duke and partners win Peru gas block.

text.p: An affiliate of U.S. energy group Duke Energy Corp and its partners have signed with Peru's state energy company to explore for natural gas in block 85 in the Ucayali Basin, Duke announced on Monday.
The deal is part of Peru's ongoing sale of exploration and production licenses to private companies and the privatization of its energy sector.

The Duke affiliate, PanEnergy Exploration and Production (Peru) Ltd, will serve as operator under the license agreement, which gives the partners the right to explore for gas in 390,000 acres in the western area of the Ucayali Basin near the town of San Alejandro.
Other partners are Buenaventura Ingenieros S.A., a Peruvian mining concern, and Mosbacher Peru L.L.C., a Peruvian subsidiary of the U.S. exploration and develoment company, Mosbacher Energy Co.
